name: Find YouTube clips by topic and export a research shortlist with Arcmira

parameters.content:
## Find YouTube clips by topic with Arcmira

For video editors and researchers building a source-linked shortlist. Enter one topic, search indexed YouTube transcripts, and download a CSV containing complete returned passages, channel and video titles, publication dates and timestamped source links. No LLM or Google account is required.

### Setup
1. Create an Arcmira API key at https://arcmira.com.
2. In Search transcripts, select an HTTP Header Auth credential with header name Authorization and value Bearer followed by your key. Store the key in credentials, never in this workflow.
3. Edit the topic in Set research topic. The workflow requests at most five passages and runs manually.
4. Execute the workflow, review the search output, and download the CSV from Export clip shortlist.

### Review the results
Coverage depends on the indexed catalog and your account. Coverage and freshness notes are retained in each row. Speaker labels may be unavailable. Timestamps locate passages, not precise edit boundaries. Watch each source before choosing clip boundaries. The workflow does not download footage or publish clips.

Requests use your account allowance. Errors stop execution; the workflow never substitutes a lower-quality transcript source. API documentation: https://arcmira.com/docs.

Use the CSV as a review sheet, or replace the export node with your Google Sheets destination.
